title: Part 13 — Knowledge Security Verification
description: Validates RBAC/ABAC isolation, secret leakage prevention, indirect prompt injection defense, and red-team resilience.

assertions.name: assert_rbac_abac_enforcement
assertions.message: Granular RBAC/ABAC access control enforced with 100% precision across clearance and department attributes

assertions.name: assert_secret_leakage_prevention
assertions.message: Automated secret scrubber sanitized API keys, cloud tokens, and PII with zero leakage

details.scrubbed_sample: Configuration: AWS_KEY=[REDACTED_AWS_KEY] and OPENAI_API_KEY=[REDACTED_API_KEY] SSN is [REDACTED_SSN].

assertions.name: assert_prompt_injection_defense
assertions.message: Indirect prompt injection detector quarantined 2 malicious chunks and allowed 2 benign chunks

assertions.name: assert_red_team_multi_tenant_isolation
assertions.message: Red-team validation verified 48/48 attack vectors intercepted at the security gateway with 0 privilege breaches
